target_paper.title: Me, Myself, and AI: The Situational Awareness Dataset (SAD) for LLMs
target_paper.original_source: appendix Table 7 (v1): gpt-4o SAD-mini 62.3 (SAD 46.2, SAD-lite 47.3); sad/<task>/results.csv gpt-4o plain rows; repository website table SAD-mini 59.4 with the full-SAD task weights

generation.substitute_snapshot: gpt-4o-2024-05-13 replaces the paper's headline 'GPT-4-Turbo' (gpt-4-0125-preview, retired 2026-03-26); the repository's gpt-4o runs are dated 24-05-13 / 24-06-27, when the alias resolved to this snapshot (decision 2026-09-18)
generation.parameters: temperature 0; max_tokens 20 (facts_*, influence: evalugator default, request_args {}) / 10 (stages_*, template request_args); system + user message from mcq_with_you_specifier (sad/templates.py) or the stages prompt_above/prompt_below templates; choice order / template / phrase identical to the archived 2024 gpt-4o run; no seed parameter

results.judged_by: automatic rule per ANALYSIS_PLAN section 1 (card: SAD-mini within original +/- 2 SE, above chance 45.0, far below upper baseline 84.8, category ordering kept); human double-coding pending
results.note: substitute snapshot (gpt-4o-2024-05-13 for the retired gpt-4-0125-preview arm). Judged on the paper's SAD-mini convention (unweighted mean of the five tasks, Table 7 v1 = 62.3); the repository-weighted value (website 59.4) is reported as a secondary row. influence is scored on its 256 public items (the paper's 320 include a private test set). Public per-item file: runs/W4400435289/items_public.jsonl (ids + prompt sha256 + parsed letters only); calls.jsonl stays private/encrypted under the SAD anti-contamination policy. finish_reasons: {"stop": 8630, "length": 85}

reproducibility_frictions_observed: the paper's 'GPT-4-Turbo' is gpt-4-0125-preview (retired); the only still-callable experimental arm is gpt-4o, run under the undated alias and reported only in the v1 appendix Table 7
evalugator (the eval library) is an unpinned git dependency and is not vendored; rendering and parsing were re-implemented from the SAD templates and verified against the archived prompts/outputs
the archived evalresult files show the answer parser changed between the April and June 2024 runs (bare-letter prefixes such as 'Both ...' were accepted as B in April, rejected in June)
the paper reports SAD-mini as the unweighted mean of five tasks (62.3) while the repository's own aggregation renormalises the full-SAD weights (59.4); the paper does not state the convention
the repository results tables were regenerated after the v1 paper (self_recognition and count_tokens re-run 24-07-04/05), so SAD 46.4 vs 46.2 in the paper
influence holds back 64 private items: the public SAD-mini has 2,905 items, not 2,969
SAD data must stay encrypted (anti-contamination policy): the L1 archive of this card cannot be published in plaintext
